title: Sarbacher known to Australian nuclear engineers; Woomera

tellings.quote: Ross Coloulthart has some interesting data points around some of the nuclear engineers,

plain: The American scientist Robert Sarbacher was known to some Australian nuclear engineers in the 1950s, a story tied to Woomera, Australia's remote rocket and weapons test site. Michels mentions it only in passing, saying the Australian journalist Ross Coulthart "has some interesting data points" about those engineers, and gives no details himself.
